# tharsis_workspace_role_binding (Resource)

Defines and manages a workspace role binding. A workspace role binding confers a role on a workspace: the role's permissions become available to the workspace's job caller at the workspace's direct parent namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tharsis_workspace_role_binding" "wrb" {
  workspace_id = tharsis_workspace.this.id
  role_name    = "deployer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String) The name of the role bound to the workspace.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID or TRN of the workspace this role binding applies to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String identifier of the workspace role binding.
